title: Repolling At 3 Booths In Agra Tomorrow For Legislative Council Polls
content: The voting that took place at these specific polling stations on October 23 has been declared void under Section 58A(2)(a) of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, a press release issued by the Chief Electoral Officer's office said.

title: "Welcome Move For Aviation Sector": Vijay Gets Rare Praise From Centre
content: Vijay's government had yesterday cut the value added tax (VAT) on aviation turbine fuel (ATF) from 29% to 16% at Chennai airport and to 1% at other airports in the state.

title: Judge who awarded 36 death sentences in 16 months transferred to family court
content: Judge Ravi Kumar Diwakar has been transferred to the family court after awarding multiple death sentences. He gained national attention for his decisions in Muzaffarnagar, including a notable case of a husband burning his wife. His tenure included recalling numerous pending cases, raising questions regarding administrative authority. Diwakar previously faced threats following his involvement in a high-profile mosque survey case.

title: KL Rahul's horror show: Duck followed by bizarre hit-wicket dismissal
content: KL Rahul struggled in the first unofficial Test against New Zealand A, scoring only four runs in two innings. In the first innings, he was dismissed for a duck after edging a catch to the wicketkeeper. His second innings ended in a bizarre hit-wicket dismissal as he accidentally struck the stumps with his bat. Rahul's two failures contributed to India A's batting collapse in the match.

title: Toddler found dead inside temple with deep neck cut; elder brother held
content: A one-and-a-half-year-old boy was allegedly murdered inside a Durga temple in Patna district. The accused, Ajit Kumar, is the elder brother of the victim, Manish Kumar. Police believe that Ajit used a sharp agricultural tool in the commission of the crime. Investigators are examining the motive and circumstances surrounding the tragic incident. Evidence is being collected to establish a clearer picture of the events that occurred.

title: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan shift donations towards AI and science
content: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan are investing $50 million to establish STEM labs and an AI center at Sacramento State University. This generous donation aims to transform vacant state office buildings into a thriving downtown campus. California Governor Gavin Newsom emphasized this initiative will enhance the tech job talent pipeline, while the couple shifts their philanthropic efforts toward biomedical AI, aligning with Meta’s vision for innovation and education.

title: Operation Trident: Rs 100 cr hawala transactions exposed, 18 arrested in drug crackdown
content: Union home minister Amit Shah announced Operation Trident, which targeted an international narcotics cartel in India. The operation, conducted in Assam, Mizoram, and Manipur, uncovered significant hawala transactions and led to arrests. Authorities froze numerous bank accounts and seized illegal items, including detonators and cash. Shah emphasized the government's commitment to eradicating drug networks by December 31, 2029.

title: France’s economic woes: Debt nears 122% of GDP, growth forecast at just 0.4%
content: France is grappling with severe economic challenges, marked by soaring public debt nearing 122% of GDP. With government expenditure exceeding 57% of the nation's economic output, the forecast of just a 0.4% growth raises concerns over financial stability. Protests centered on the rising cost of living showcase deeper political fractures. As the presidential succession nears, the economy stands as a pivotal issue for the electorate.

title: Melanie Griffith paid $3.75M for a 1937 Hollywood house, here's how much its worth now
content: Melanie Griffith's exquisite former Los Angeles estate has made its reappearance in the market, now asking for $5.8 million following significant renovations. Constructed in 1937, this stunning mix of Spanish design and contemporary elements boasts three spacious bedrooms and three bathrooms, alongside serene outdoor spaces. Originally acquired for $4.7 million in 2024, the property has navigated various price shifts.

title: Rocket Mortgage founder turns $1 billion Detroit pledge into nonprofit fund
content: Billionaire Dan Gilbert announces a remarkable $1 billion investment aimed at revitalizing Detroit's Renaissance Center and nearby riverfront. This project will be overseen by a nonprofit organization that emphasizes community benefits with no profits going to Gilbert. The plan includes the creation of modern housing and a vibrant walkable district complete with parks and entertainment venues.

title: Selena Gomez's October charity gala raised $2.7M for youth mental health
content: Selena Gomez proudly hosted the fourth annual Rare Impact Fund Benefit in Los Angeles, successfully raising significant funds for mental health initiatives. The evening took an exciting turn when her husband, Benny Blanco, bid an impressive $25,000 for a special modeling experience with Gomez’s glam team. During the event, she reaffirmed her dedication to youth mental health and introduced the Katherine Short Legacy Award, with a remarkable total of $2.

title: Fake passport, asylum plan: How US tracked down gangster Himanshu Bhau
content: Himanshu Bhau and Neeraj Faridpuria attempted to exploit immigration laws to gain asylum in the US. Their plan backfired when they were detained by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement. Both individuals used fake passports to evade law enforcement for several years. Indian and US authorities confirmed Bhau's identity through cross-verification of their backgrounds. Efforts are underway to expedite their deportation to India following their detention.

title: Biosimilar drugs breaking high-cost barrier to cancer immunotherapy
content: Recent changes in cancer care in India show an increase in immunotherapy prescriptions due to affordable biosimilars. Doctors report that the availability of cheaper versions of nivolumab has improved patient access to treatment. Research indicates that lower doses may be effective for Indian patients, contributing to the affordability of therapy. Although progress has been made, significant challenges remain regarding drug availability and hospital practices.

title: Violent protests in Arunachal against Siang dam; MLAs’ homes looted, NHPC set ablaze
content: Protests erupted in Pasighat, Arunachal Pradesh, against the proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project on Friday night. After a 12-hour bandh ended peacefully, violent clashes began, injuring over 40 police personnel. The mob vandalized properties, set fire to government buildings, and damaged several police vehicles during the incident. Arunachal Pradesh Chief Minister Pema Khandu expressed concern and offered to hold talks with protesting groups.

title: ‘Blood clot in brain’: How refusing auto driver’s fare turned fatal for B'luru advocate
content: A Bengaluru advocate was found unconscious on the Outer Ring Road and later died in the hospital. Initially thought to have suffered a heart attack, his family's suspicion prompted a post-mortem examination. This examination revealed a blood clot in his brain caused by an assault related to a fare dispute. Police have arrested auto-rickshaw driver Pruthviraj Appajigowda while seeking others present during the incident.

title: Protests sweep France, Spain as masked mobs loot shops, clash with cops; 1,100 held
content: Videos shared online showed people trapped inside shops, including the department store El Corte Ingles, after shutters were lowered to prevent looting. Other footage showed hooded demonstrators dressed in black smashing shop windows and taking goods, sometimes encouraged by people watching online. Barcelona Mayor Jaume Collboni warned that acts of vandalism "will not go unpunished".

title: Will IPL 2027 be MS Dhoni's last dance? CSK legend drops big hint
content: MS Dhoni has indicated he will assess his fitness before deciding on playing IPL 2027. He humorously stated that the fitness report will influence his decision regarding another season. Dhoni's contribution to the game has evolved, primarily impacting his role in the batting order. As captain, he has led CSK to significant successes including five IPL titles. CSK has faced challenges in recent seasons since his leadership transition.

title: Tiger Shroff firing: Turkish, desi pistols recovered in Surat, youth held in MP
content: Cops have arrested Pranjal Thakaran, a 22-year-old student, regarding the recent firing incident involving actor Tiger Shroff. The police recovered a Turkish-made Zigana pistol and a country-made firearm during the investigation. Thakaran is believed to be linked to the weapon supply chain and the shooter involved in the case. The weapons were found in Surat after an extensive search effort by the authorities over several hours.

title: Angel Reese donates $12,000 to support young girls' basketball dreams
content: Angel Reese has founded the Angel C. Reese Foundation with a mission to uplift young girls through sports, education, and financial knowledge. Recently, she contributed $12,000 to the Joan & Bert Hash Fund, dedicated to girls' basketball. The foundation's initiatives aim to offer resources and encouragement to aspiring female athletes.

title: Tom Brady supports ZEvent fundraising campaign with generous donation
content: Tom Brady donated a signed helmet and football to French streamer Domingo for the ZEvent charity fundraiser. Announced by NFL France, the contribution could help raise significant money for charitable causes. Brady also congratulated participants and mentioned the NFL's first regular-season game in Paris in October 2026. The seven-time Super Bowl champion, known for collecting sports memorabilia, used two prized career-related items to support the fundraising effort.

title: Team India's massive T20I record goes unnoticed; team miles ahead of Pakistan
content: India became the first team to play 300 men's T20 Internationals and also recorded their 200th win in the format. They reached the milestone in style, chasing down New Zealand's 180/5 with one ball to spare after losing five wickets for just 70 runs.

title: ‘Will never be safe’: Houthis warn as Riyadh airport resumes flights
content: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh has resumed flight operations following a significant security situation. The airport management has designated specific terminals for domestic and international flights, effective immediately. Meanwhile, the Houthi military spokesperson has reiterated threats against the airport, labeling it a military target. Airlines such as Air India and Air India Express have suspended services to Saudi Arabia as a precaution.

title: Sebi plans curbs on terminal misuse, graded compliance for market intermediaries
content: In a proactive move, market regulator Sebi is rolling out initiatives to curb the misuse of brokers' trading terminals and bolster compliance efforts. The focus is also on enhancing cybersecurity while safely testing AI tools. Sebi's vision encompasses streamlining regulations, promoting responsible technology, fostering deeper market engagement, and ensuring broader access for investors, particularly in underrepresented smaller towns and villages, while urging brokers to assess client risks more comprehensively.

title: Lula's comeback bid vs Bolsonaro's son: Brazil votes in high-stakes run-off
content: Brazil gears up for a thrilling presidential run-off featuring incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva against challenger Flávio Bolsonaro. Despite Bolsonaro's lead in the first round, Lula's vibrant rallies aim to rally supporters and boost voter turnout. Bolsonaro focuses on tackling crime and economic reform, while Lula champions national dignity and promises transformative progress. This election could reshape Brazil's future, with millions poised to make their voices heard.

title: US Fed expected to hold rates as inflation, energy costs weigh ahead of midterms
content: The US Federal Reserve is expected to keep interest rates unchanged in its upcoming meeting next week. Analysts suggest this decision comes despite ongoing inflation pressures and looming midterm elections. The Federal Reserve has struggled to meet its long-term inflation target due to rising prices affecting multiple sectors. Heightened energy costs after global conflicts are contributing significantly to inflation pressures.

title: ‘Prioritise welfare over military directives’: India raps Pak on minority rights
content: Speaking at an interactive dialogue with the Special Rapporteur on Minority Issues at the UN General Assembly's Third Committee, India's First Secretary at the Permanent Mission to the UN, Raghoo Puri, called out Pakistan's conduct and said its representatives should focus on the welfare of their own people instead of taking directions from the military.

title: No EC nod needed for voter to sue candidate over false information: Supreme Court
content: A bench of Justices Dipankar Datta and Sheel Nagu quashed the Karnataka HC order which had held that “right given to the voter is only to file an election petition, and not to register a private complaint of crime which is the duty of the Election Commission, if it wants to do so”.

title: Drawn in same group, IND-PAK set to clash on Nov 22 in Rising Asia Cup
content: India A will open their campaign against Nepal on November 20 before taking on Pakistan A two days later. They will play their final group-stage match against the UAE on November 24.

title: Farooq Abdullah's comments on Pakistan and Kashmir draw flak
content: Farooq urged NC workers and legislators to remain loyal to the party, whether in power or not, as he touched on a range of issues in his speech. “Hold on to the truth. Speaking the truth is not easy, but unless you remain truthful and stand up for what is right, your future will never be secure,” the veteran said.

title: Princess’s gambit: At 11, Bodhana Sivanandan is an international master
content: Sivanandan, who lives in the London suburb of Harrow, broke the 38-year-old record held by Hungarian chess legend Judit Polgar, widely regarded as the greatest female player in chess history, after winning her final-round game at the European Women’s Club Cup in Budva, Montenegro on Friday. Polgar had qualified at the age of 12 in 1988.

title: Interview | ‘AAP had 4.5 years to end drug menace, gangsterism in Punjab’: Pilot

It will be a bipolar contest over who can lead Punjab better. There will be other players like Amritpal Singh’s party, but people of Punjab don’t give a fractured mandate," Sachin Pilot said.

title: Trump votes in Florida midterms, defends controversial ad, doubles down on Iran
content: Trump and first lady Melania Trump arrived together at a polling station at the Palm Beach County Supervisor of Elections office in West Palm Beach. The president had spent the morning at a nearby golf course before casting his vote. Trump has previously faced criticism for voting by mail despite repeatedly attacking the practice. Asked whether he had voted for candidates from his own party, he replied, "Very much so."

title: Suspicious pigeon with coded ring, Pak currency causes a flutter in Jammu

On Saturday, the pigeon was found near a temple in Samba’s border area of Mawa around 6.40am and was immediately captured by locals after they spotted a ring tied to its leg.

He intended to discuss the issue with govt, educational institutions, academia, research institutions and industry in order to forge stronger partnerships, he said.

title: 6.5-magnitude earthquake strikes Bonin Islands region of Japan
content:
Japan and Vanuatu Islands struck by two separate earthquakes Sunday morning

A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck the Bonin Islands region of Japan early Sunday, news agency PTI reported, citing the United States Geological Survey (USGS). No tsunami warning was issued following the strong earthquake, and there were no immediate reports of damage. Japan is prone to earthquakes and has experienced several major tremors in its history, causing significant loss of life and extensive damage to property. Separately, a magnitude 6.16 earthquake struck the Vanuatu Islands on Sunday morning, according to the German Research Centre for Geosciences (GFZ). title: New Jersey breaks ground on $70m, 275-home project at abandoned Army site
